rule.description: A private module-level function, class or constant of the gspread package is unreachable when no live reference reaches it in the package, its public entry points or tests. Import-only, annotation-only, unreachable-site and always-false-switch-body references do not keep a definition alive; liveness iterates to a fixed point so mutually-referencing dead chains are reported in full.

checks.description: Pylint rule W9901 (symbol gspread-unreachable-private) flags private module-level implementations of the gspread package that no live reference reaches.
checks.detected_relation: private module-level definition -> {no live reference | only reachable from unreachable sites | imported but never called | referenced only inside an always-disabled switch body}
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Such a definition is obsolete code left after the 6.0 transport and OAuth migration; nothing the library supports can ever execute it, yet it still carries stale dependency edges, by-name registries and a permanently disabled migration switch that maintenance must keep in agreement.

excluded.reason: private class, but kept live because the dead registry _LEGACY_CLIENT_ENGINES references it in a module-level dict literal; it becomes unreachable only after the registry is removed and is therefore dependent scaffolding, not an independently flagged entry
private always-false migration switch; referenced by its own if-condition so it stays live, while the guarded branch it controls is the dead region. Removed only together with that branch
